name: Elah
bio: Elah son of Baasha succeeded his father as king of Israel, reigning two years from Tirzah. While he was there getting drunk in the home of Arza, the palace steward, his own official Zimri, commander of half his chariots, struck him down and killed him, then seized the throne and exterminated Elah's entire family — the fulfillment of the LORD's judgment against Baasha's house spoken through the prophet Jehu (1 Kings 16:8-13).
